mechanism: Bisacodyl may increase intestinal motility and reduce atomoxetine absorption; atomoxetine's noradrenergic effects may worsen bisacodyl-induced electrolyte disturbances and dehydration.
action: Separate administration timing by at least 2 hours; monitor for dehydration, electrolyte imbalances, and reduced atomoxetine efficacy; avoid chronic bisacodyl use in patients on atomoxetine.
